title: Bonding
html:
Bonding is a cosmetic and restorative treatment option. Composite resin materials are bonded directly onto the teeth. This both restores function and provides a more aesthetic appearance. Bonding may be recommended for one or more of the following:
  • To repair chipped or cracked teeth
  • To improve discolored teeth
  • To close gaps between teeth
  • To lengthen one or more teeth
  • To reshape one or more teeth
  • To protect an exposed tooth root
Bonding is a safe and effective solution that can often be completed in just one visit. To find out if bonding may be right for your child, contact Mason Park Dental.
